operations.old:
KEEP self or one ally and exactly two subsequent qualifying attack/spell occurrences. NEW require a willing perceived allied creature, including self, within 120 feet and line of effect; replace the operational Instantaneous shorthand with an attached, nonconcentration ward lasting 60 elapsed seconds from resolution, with two uses and no recipient Reaction. Its existence does not require the caster to remain nearby or conscious after establishment. One operative same-spell family per recipient across casters: a successful new ward replaces the old and discards its remainder. Establishment of this ward is not itself a use-consuming occurrence. A failed/countered new cast does not itself replace an older ward. Rest and token/owner/scene changes replenish nothing.

NEW event identity: one nonspell attack is one occurrence, irrespective of its separate damage types/riders. Distinct Multiattack attacks are distinct occurrences. One spell's immediate resolution is one occurrence per recipient, grouping all that cast's immediate beams/missiles/attacks even when rolled sequentially. Do not count the same spell and its constituent attacks twice. A later real source-scheduled tick, paid maintenance pulse, delayed occurrence or entry occurrence is a separate event, keyed to its actual occurrence ID, not another cast. Mere passive ongoing presence, a stat query or a renamed packet is no occurrence. A spell-associated weapon damage rider in its parent hit is not a second event unless its own source genuinely creates a separate resolution. Distinct actually cast spells inside a composite Action remain distinct casts/occurrences.

Uses are automatic, not optional damage shields. An actual miss, successful save, zero-damage hit or resolving nondamaging beneficial spell still consumes a use. CORRECTION to the proposed universally pre-roll timing: resolve any legal target-substitution window at its existing source timing; automatically commit the use on the attack's actual final recipient before hit/miss consequences and damage, even if the unchanged attack die has already been rolled. There is no post-result choice to save the use. For a spell, commit before that recipient's first actual resolution component. A canceled attack never made, a spell countered before effect resolution, a guessed empty space with no actual recipient, or an area portion excluded by total cover consumes none. Do not charge the abandoned intended target after a genuine retarget.

At the finite-prevention stage, after that recipient's defenses and before post-defense sharing/temp HP, prevent all otherwise eligible damage from the covered occurrence to that recipient. Retain distinct underlying damage roots/rolls; grouping protection does not merge damage packets or create extra Wound/trigger events. Bloodbond/Veinlock pre-mitigation splits first assign the real raw shares. NEW explicit admission for this interface: a positive pre-mitigation share may consume/claim a ward use for its actual recipient against that parent occurrence, without making that recipient hit or transferring nondamage riders; group by original attack/spell occurrence and ward recipient, so that occurrence cannot charge the same ward twice. A zero share creates no share-only occurrence. Each such recipient still has only its own one defense/prevention stage. Post-defense transferred branches explicitly skipping prevention neither consume a new ward use nor receive this prevention, regardless of retained spell/attack provenance. Direct HP payment, HP assignment, environmental falling and nonattack nonspell harm are not eligible by association.

A hit is still a hit; independently applicable control, movement, Maiming, nondamage riders, item damage, lethal assignments and source-specific concentration ending remain. Positive-damage-dependent riders recheck actual remaining damage. Prevention produces no transfer, reflection, stored damage, healing or restored payment. Covered components of the second occurrence remain authorized until that one occurrence finishes, then the depleted ward ends; an unrelated interleaved event gains nothing. Recheck actual ward existence/suppression for each still-unresolved component: a genuine dispel/expiry can stop later components but never undo already prevented damage. Suppression prevents new use commitments during the gap and prevents applying the ward while suppressed; it does not refund a previously committed occurrence use or extend the deadline. On return only the same still-live record and its actual remaining/committed occurrence may continue. Recipient death/destruction, removal or expiry ends it; prior caster death alone does not. The half-open duration excludes new occurrences at the exact deadline.
